build_BaseTransformer: build a transformer model with BaseTransformerArgs specifying dim, n_layers, n_heads, and canon_set options
create_BaseTransformerArgs: create a BaseTransformerArgs dataclass to configure model dimensions, attention heads, RoPE theta, and canon layer settings
run_cross_entropy: run cross_entropy loss computation with optional z_loss regularization on prediction and target tensors
test_RotaryEmbedding: test the RotaryEmbedding module by calling forward with seqlen or tok_idx to get precomputed freqs_cis
refactor_Attention: refactor the Attention class to toggle qk_norm, switch attn_impl between sdpa, fmha, or flex_attention
